clauses.clause: [+1]: Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
clauses.evidence: Trace, [activate [0] from battlefield targets=...]: the target slot is 0..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant] (every creature, any controller); for each target 'card gets 1 LOYALTY counter(s)', 'X gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s)', counters {} -> {PLUS_1_PLUS_1: 1}, P/T +1/+1; loyalty 4 -> 5. [activate [0] from battlefield] with no target: only the loyalty change (zero targets allowed). Packs E04_1..E04_3 repeat them with the other creatures untouched.

clauses.clause: It gains vigilance until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Trace, each [activate [0] ... targets=X]: 'X: ... keywords +VIGILANCE' and 'after the turn ends: X: keywords -VIGILANCE', for the target only. Pack E04_4 (the counter stays, vigilance gone at end of turn).

clauses.clause: [−1]: Whenever a creature attacks this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
clauses.evidence: Trace, [activate [1] from battlefield]: only the cost (loyalty 4 -> 3, 'ABILITY_ACTIVATED card ... 1, False, -1'); no attack follows it, so the delayed trigger never fires and the counters are never shown. Packs E04_5 (each attacker gets exactly one counter, a creature that stays home none), E04_6 (the effect ends with the turn: an attacker in the next turn gets none) and E04_9 (two attackers put two triggers on the stack: after one resolves, only one attacker has its counter).

clauses.clause: [−6]: Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain flying until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Trace: '- ability [2] not activatable from battlefield: cost:loyalty:4<6': the board's 4 loyalty cannot pay it, so nothing of the ability is shown. The tree reads right (MODIFY_PT +2/+2 and GRANT_ABILITY flying, both ALL creatures you control, both until end of turn, loyalty -6). Packs E04_7 (+2/+2 and flying for my creatures only, a creature that enters later gets neither, loyalty paid) and E04_8 (both gone at end of turn).

survived: each occurrence -> once per event at 1/1/effect
